answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow: each identity posts a 70-credit bond and registers its fingerprint at a jetty checkpoint in the canyon ledger. Each epoch an auditor recomputes it from the river of work; drift over 5% or a copied fingerprint burns the bond. Filings cost 40+6(k-1); 1,000 forged identities cost 3,037,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented-fingerprint ring must forge 1,000 histories. A truthful agent registers once, spends 40, keeps the bond.
